summary: Iteration 4 — JobMatch AI admin approval flow + enriched admin APIs + reject-with-reason sheet + mobile admin bottom bar. BACKEND (new /app/backend/tests/test_approval_flow.py, 20 pytest tests, 20/20 PASS against preview https://matchjob-india.preview.emergentagent.com): RBAC 4/4 (no-token /admin/metrics 403, candidate/recruiter get 403 on /admin/jobs|/admin/users|/admin/metrics); ApprovalFlow 11/11 (recruiter POST /recruiter/jobs -> status=pending_approval; candidate GET /jobs excludes it; admin GET /admin/metrics returns pending_jobs/rejected_jobs/shortlisted/active_candidates/active_recruiters all present with pending_jobs>=1; GET /admin/jobs?status=pending_approval returns item with recruiter_name AND recruiter_email populated; POST /admin/jobs/{id}/moderate {action:approve} -> job moves to published, candidate /jobs now includes it, admin /admin/jobs?status=published includes it; candidate POST /applications -> 200 with recruiter_id, candidate_email, read=false; duplicate POST -> 409; recruiter dashboard metrics.total_applications>=1 and recent_applications contains new app; POST /recruiter/applications/{id}/stage {stage:shortlisted} -> admin metrics.shortlisted increments; GET /admin/applications?stage=shortlisted filters correctly and includes recruiter_name; stage:hired -> admin metrics.hires increments; candidate /notifications includes stage_* entries); RejectFlow 3/3 (second recruiter job -> admin moderate action:reject with note -> job appears in /admin/jobs?status=rejected, hidden from candidate /jobs, visible to recruiter /recruiter/jobs with status=rejected); AdminUsersEnriched 2/2 (/admin/users?role=candidate returns profile_completion, has_resume, applications_count; ?role=recruiter returns company_name, jobs_posted, jobs_published, applications_received). FRONTEND desktop 1280x800: admin login lands /overview, all 12 sidebar testIDs present (sidebar-overview/approvals/published/rejected/review/users/candidates/recruiters/applications/analytics/reports/settings) and each click navigates and renders non-empty content (body text length 1598-9423, URL updates per route) — no blank screens. FRONTEND mobile 390x844: admin bottom bar shows 5 tabs (tab-overview/approvals/users/applications/settings) all present and navigate correctly. Recruiter mobile create-job via /job-form: submit button posts job -> toast 'Job submitted for admin approval.' appears (data-testid=toast-message) -> auto-navigates to /postings -> 'Pending Approval' badge + 'Awaiting admin review before going live.' text both visible on the new card. Code review confirmed applicant detail buttons (applicant-interview-stage-button, applicant-hired-button, applicant-view-resume-button in /app/frontend/app/applicant/[id].tsx:92-96), reject sheet (reject-reason-input, reject-job-confirm in AdminJobs.tsx:81-82), apply messages (apply/[id].tsx:49,55: 'Application submitted successfully.' / 'Already applied.'), api.ts 401/403 messages (api.ts:132,134 'Your session has expired. Please login again.' / 'You don't have permission to access this.'), and job-form.tsx:69 toast text present. Deprecated 'shadow*' style props warning still logged in web preview (carryover).

ui_bugs.issue: Submit button title reads 'Publish job' for recruiter even though recruiter jobs now always go to pending_approval; label is misleading (user clicks 'Publish' but actually submits for approval). Toast and routing are correct, only button copy is stale.

react_native_issues.issue: Carryover: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' warning still printed on login/admin screens. Reference: /app/frontend/src/ui.tsx and screen StyleSheet blocks.

action_items: LOW: rename recruiter job-form submit button title from 'Publish job' to 'Submit for approval' (job-form.tsx line 127) — current label is misleading now that all recruiter jobs go to pending_approval.
Carryover: migrate RN shadow* style props to unified boxShadow in /app/frontend/src/ui.tsx.
Carryover (iter 3): redeploy production backend (matchjob-india.emergent.host) — still stale per iter 3 unless redeployed since. Not re-verified this round.

Operational note (for future test agents): the recruiter test company has job_post_limit=2; close any lingering QA jobs via POST /recruiter/jobs/{id}/status {status:'closed'} before posting new ones, or set higher plan quota for the TEST recruiter.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_admin.py moderate() correctly branches approve/reject and persists moderation_note; notify() fires only when posted_by set — admin-created jobs (posted_by=None) will not notify a recruiter, which is correct behavior.

routes_main.py apply flow stores recruiter_id (from job.posted_by), candidate_email and read=false — enriched fields verified via POST /applications response and GET /recruiter/dashboard recent_applications.

routes_recruiter.py create_job() counts active = published|pending_approval|paused; this is the correct denominator but it caused tests to 402 until QA jobs were force-closed. Consider raising job_post_limit for the TEST recruiter in seed.py to avoid flakes.

api.ts:132 session-expired message is correctly scoped to non-login paths (if (!path.startsWith('/auth/login'))); api.ts:134 permission message only fires when detail is non-string. Both match the spec.
/app/frontend/app/(admin)/_layout.tsx uses width>=900 threshold for sidebar vs bottom bar; verified via viewport 1280 (sidebar) and 390 (5-tab bottom bar) — matches spec.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (admin desktop sidebar 12/12, admin mobile bottom bar 5/5, recruiter mobile create-job -> toast -> /postings 'Pending Approval'); applicant-detail/reject-sheet UI not click-tested due to recruiter test-company quota and session re-login flakiness in automation — verified by code review

All backend contract changes (pending_approval default, enriched admin APIs, stage filter, application enrichment, metrics additions, reject moderation note) verified end-to-end via automated pytest.
